name: Priscilla Barielle
original_name: プリシラ・バーリエル
source:
One of the candidates for the royal election to become the 42nd King of Lugnica and head of Barielle House. Priscilla has an extravagant self-centered personality, because of how much the world turns into her favor. Even though she is only 19, Priscilla has had 8 husbands who have all mysteriously died, despite that the lands she has acquired have prospered under her thanks to her almost supernatural good luck at guessing.

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Re:Zero_-Starting_Life_in_Another_World-_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
